Conservative.summary: Only zero-impact tweaks. Nothing you use day-to-day changes behaviour.
Conservative.recommendedFor: 16 GB+ RAM or SSD systems that just want less background waste.

Balanced.summary: Browser background trimming, telemetry off, Widgets off, memory compression and HDD-aware paging.
Balanced.recommendedFor: 8-12 GB RAM laptops and desktops (the sweet spot).

Aggressive.summary: Everything in Balanced plus stricter background-app limits and visual effect trimming.
Aggressive.recommendedFor: 4-6 GB RAM systems or mechanical (HDD) drives under heavy load.

flushTargets.name: SearchHost
flushTargets.label: Windows Search UI host (restarts on demand)

tweaks.title: Disable Edge Startup Boost
tweaks.description: Stops Microsoft Edge from pre-loading itself at Windows sign-in and staying resident in RAM when no window is open.
tweaks.impact: Saves roughly 100-300 MB while Edge is closed. Edge's first launch takes about a second longer.

tweaks.title: Stop Edge running in the background
tweaks.description: Edge normally keeps extensions and apps running after the last window closes. This makes Edge fully exit when you close it.
tweaks.impact: Frees all Edge memory when closed. Extensions that notify you in the background will not run while Edge is closed.

tweaks.title: Put idle Edge tabs to sleep
tweaks.description: Enables Sleeping Tabs and sets how quickly inactive tabs release their memory (15 min Conservative, 5 min Balanced, 30 s Aggressive).
tweaks.impact: Large savings with many tabs open. A sleeping tab reloads when you click it.

tweaks.title: Enable Edge Efficiency Mode
tweaks.description: Lets Edge throttle background tabs and reduce CPU and memory work when tabs are not visible.
tweaks.impact: Lower background CPU and memory churn. Background animations may run slower.

tweaks.title: Turn off the Edge sidebar
tweaks.description: Removes the Edge sidebar and the standalone sidebar, each of which hosts extra web views (Copilot, Shopping, Tools).
tweaks.impact: Removes several hidden renderer processes. The sidebar button disappears from Edge.

tweaks.title: Turn off Copilot in Edge
tweaks.description: Disables the built-in Copilot integration and its page-context reader in Edge.
tweaks.impact: Removes the Copilot web view and its background work. Use copilot.microsoft.com in a tab if needed.

tweaks.title: Stop Edge pre-loading pages
tweaks.description: Disables speculative pre-connecting and pre-rendering of links Edge thinks you might click next.
tweaks.impact: Fewer hidden renderer processes and less network use. Some links open a fraction of a second slower.

tweaks.title: Turn off Edge shopping, recommendations and Math Solver
tweaks.description: Disables the shopping assistant, in-browser recommendations and the Math Solver feature.
tweaks.impact: Less background scripting on every page you visit.

tweaks.title: Cap the Edge disk cache at 256 MB
tweaks.description: Limits how large Edge's on-disk cache can grow.
tweaks.impact: Less disk churn, especially on mechanical drives. Rarely visited sites may re-download assets.

tweaks.title: Stop Chrome and Brave running in the background
tweaks.description: Makes Google Chrome and Brave fully exit when their last window is closed.
tweaks.impact: Frees all browser memory when closed. Has no effect if neither browser is installed.

tweaks.title: Turn off Windows Widgets
tweaks.description: Disables the Widgets board (news, weather, stocks), which runs its own web view host in the background.
tweaks.impact: Typically saves 100-250 MB. The Widgets button disappears from the taskbar.

tweaks.title: Remove Bing web results from Start search
tweaks.description: Start menu search shows only local apps, files and settings instead of also querying Bing.
tweaks.impact: Faster, lighter Start search with no network round-trip. Web results no longer appear in Start.

tweaks.title: Turn off Game DVR background recording
tweaks.description: Disables Xbox Game Bar background capture, which can keep recording buffers in memory.
tweaks.impact: Saves memory and GPU work. Game Bar clip recording stops working.

tweaks.title: Block Store apps from running in the background
tweaks.description: Prevents Microsoft Store (UWP) apps from running background tasks when they are not open.
tweaks.impact: Noticeable savings on low-RAM systems. Store apps such as Mail or Phone Link only update or notify while open.

tweaks.title: Turn off transparency effects
tweaks.description: Disables the blur and transparency effects on the taskbar, Start menu and windows for the current user.
tweaks.impact: Slightly less GPU and compositor memory. Windows looks flatter.

tweaks.title: Disable Connected User Experiences and Telemetry
tweaks.description: Turns off the DiagTrack service, which collects and uploads diagnostic data in the background.
tweaks.impact: Less background CPU, disk and network activity. Windows Update and Defender are not affected.

tweaks.title: Set Downloaded Maps Manager to manual
tweaks.description: The offline maps service only starts when the Maps app needs it.
tweaks.impact: Small saving. No visible change unless you use offline maps, which still work on demand.

tweaks.title: Disable WAP Push message routing
tweaks.description: Turns off dmwappushservice, a telemetry and device-management message router that home users rarely need.
tweaks.impact: Small saving. Do not apply on work PCs managed by an MDM such as Intune.

tweaks.title: Disable Connected Devices Platform
tweaks.description: Turns off CDPSvc, which powers Nearby Sharing, Phone Link and cross-device app resume.
tweaks.impact: Saves memory and background network chatter. Nearby Sharing and Phone Link stop working.

tweaks.title: Disable the Windows Search indexer (opt-in)
tweaks.description: Stops the indexer that continuously scans your files. Recommended only if you use an alternative such as Everything.
tweaks.impact: Big win on mechanical drives: no background indexing I/O. Start, Outlook and Settings search become slower and less complete.

tweaks.title: Enable memory compression
tweaks.description: Windows compresses rarely used memory pages in RAM instead of writing them to the page file on disk.
tweaks.impact: More effective RAM and fewer slow disk reads. This is the Windows default; WinBreathe makes sure it was not turned off.

tweaks.title: Enable memory page combining
tweaks.description: Windows merges identical memory pages from different processes into a single shared copy.
tweaks.impact: Small RAM saving at negligible CPU cost.

tweaks.title: Stop app pre-launch on mechanical drives
tweaks.description: Disables Application Pre-Launch, which speculatively loads Store apps into memory at boot. Only offered on HDD systems.
tweaks.impact: Quieter, faster boot on HDDs. Some Store apps open slightly slower the first time.

tweaks.title: Use a fixed-size page file
tweaks.description: Replaces the auto-growing page file with a fixed size (1.5 x RAM, 4-12 GB) so it never fragments on a hard drive. Skipped if free disk space would drop below 15 GB.
tweaks.impact: Prevents stutters caused by page-file growth on HDDs and low-RAM PCs. Takes effect after a reboot.
